prompt_text: In the post, the text above the image makes a claim comparing the popularity of Pop and Latin. Identify the according values in the chart to verify this claim. If the claim matches the visualization reply 'correct'. If not, reply 'incorrect'.

answers.post_claim_correct:
The claim in the text states that Latin was more popular than Pop this year. According to the chart, Pop has a preference percentage of 23.5%, while Latin has a preference percentage of 11.0%.

This indicates that the claim is incorrect because Pop (23.5%) is more popular than Latin (11.0%).
